fact.en: In a series circuit, all the parts are connected one after another, so the electric current has only one single path to follow.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, magkakasunod na nakakabit ang lahat ng parts, kaya iisa lang ang daanan ng electric current.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, sunod-sunod nga nagkadugtong ang tanang parts, mao nga usa ra ka agianan ang electric current.

cards.illustration: A simple loop of wire connecting a battery to three small bulbs, with arrows showing the single direction of current flow through each bulb.

fact.en:
Does the current get used up as it passes through each bulb in a series circuit?

No! The current is the same everywhere in a series circuit, so every bulb gets the same amount of electric current.
fact.tl:
Nauubos ba ang current habang dumadaan ito sa bawat bulb sa series circuit?

Hindi! Pareho ang current sa lahat ng bahagi ng series circuit, kaya bawat bulb ay tumatanggap ng parehong dami ng electric current.
fact.bis:
Mahurot ba ang current samtang moagi kini sa matag bulb sa series circuit?

Dili! Pareho ang current sa tanang parte sa series circuit, mao nga ang matag bulb makadawat ug parehong gidaghanon sa electric current.

cards.illustration: Three light bulbs in a row with identical ammeter readings shown next to each bulb, all displaying the same number.

fact.en: The total voltage from the battery in a series circuit is divided among the parts, so adding the voltage across each bulb gives the battery's total voltage.
fact.tl: Ang total voltage mula sa battery sa series circuit ay hinahati sa mga parts, kaya kapag pinagsama ang voltage sa bawat bulb, makukuha ang total voltage ng battery.
fact.bis: Ang total voltage sa battery sa series circuit gibahin sa mga parts, mao nga kon sumahon ang voltage sa matag bulb, makuha ang total voltage sa battery.

cards.illustration: A battery connected to three bulbs, with small voltage labels on each bulb that add up to the larger voltage label on the battery.

fact.en: In a series circuit, the total resistance is the sum of all the individual resistances, so adding more resistors makes the total resistance bigger.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, ang total resistance ay ang kabuuan ng lahat ng individual resistance, kaya kapag nagdagdag ng resistors, lumalaki ang total resistance.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, ang total resistance mao ang sum sa tanang individual resistance, mao nga kon magdugang ug resistors, modako ang total resistance.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three resistors, each labeled with a resistance value, and a dashed line showing their values being added together.

fact.en:
Can the total resistance in a series circuit be smaller than one of its resistors?

No! The total resistance is always greater than any single resistance in the circuit because you are adding all of them together.
fact.tl:
Pwede bang mas maliit ang total resistance sa series circuit kaysa sa isa sa mga resistors nito?

Hindi! Ang total resistance ay laging mas malaki kaysa sa kahit anong single resistance sa circuit dahil pinagsasama-sama mo silang lahat.
fact.bis:
Pwede bang mas gamay ang total resistance sa series circuit kaysa sa usa sa mga resistors?

Dili! Ang total resistance kanunay nga mas dako kaysa sa bisan unsang single resistance sa circuit tungod kay gisum nimo silang tanan.

cards.illustration: A single small resistor next to a chain of three larger resistors, with an arrow showing the chain has a much higher total resistance.

fact.en: Ohm's law says that voltage equals current times resistance, written as V = IR, which shows how these three electrical quantities are connected.
fact.tl: Sinasabi ng Ohm's law na ang voltage ay katumbas ng current times resistance, isinusulat bilang V = IR, na nagpapakita kung paano magkaugnay ang tatlong electrical quantities na ito.
fact.bis: Ang Ohm's law nag-ingon nga ang voltage katumbas sa current times resistance, gisulat isip V = IR, nga nagpakita kon giunsa pagdugtong kining tulo ka electrical quantities.

cards.illustration: A triangle diagram with V at the top and I and R at the bottom corners, showing the relationship between voltage, current, and resistance.

fact.en: An ammeter, the device that measures electric current, must be connected in series so the current flows through it and gets counted.
fact.tl: Ang ammeter, ang device na sumusukat ng electric current, ay dapat ikabit nang series para dumaan dito ang current at ito ay mabilang.
fact.bis: Ang ammeter, ang device nga nagsukod sa electric current, kinahanglan nga ikonektar nga series aron moagi ang current ug maihap kini.

cards.illustration: A circuit with an ammeter placed in the single wire path, showing the current flowing through the ammeter to reach a bulb.

fact.en:
Why is a voltmeter connected differently from an ammeter?

A voltmeter measures voltage across a component, so it is connected across the two ends of that component, not in the main path.
fact.tl:
Bakit iba ang pagkakakabit ng voltmeter kaysa sa ammeter?

Sinusukat ng voltmeter ang voltage across sa isang component, kaya ikinakabit ito sa dalawang dulo ng component na iyon, hindi sa main path.
fact.bis:
Ngano lahi man ang pagkonektar sa voltmeter kaysa sa ammeter?

Ang voltmeter nagsukod sa voltage across sa usa ka component, mao nga gikonektar kini sa duha ka tumoy sa component, dili sa main path.

cards.illustration: A bulb in a circuit with a voltmeter connected by two wires to the bulb's two terminals, measuring the voltage across the bulb.

fact.en: Schematic diagrams use standard symbols for parts like batteries, bulbs, and switches, so anyone can read and build the same circuit.
fact.tl: Ang schematic diagrams ay gumagamit ng standard symbols para sa mga parts tulad ng battery, bulb, at switch, para mabasa at mabuo ng kahit sino ang parehong circuit.
fact.bis: Ang schematic diagrams naggamit ug standard symbols para sa mga parts sama sa battery, bulb, ug switch, aron mabasa ug matukod sa bisan kinsa ang parehong circuit.

cards.illustration: A simple schematic drawing with standard symbols for a battery, a switch, and a bulb connected by straight lines representing wires.

fact.en: Series circuits are simple to design and easy to troubleshoot because all the parts are connected in one clear path.
fact.tl: Ang series circuits ay simple i-design at madaling i-troubleshoot dahil ang lahat ng parts ay nakakabit sa isang malinaw na daanan.
fact.bis: Ang series circuits simple nga i-design ug sayon nga i-troubleshoot tungod kay ang tanang parts konektado sa usa ka klaro nga agianan.

cards.illustration: A neatly drawn series circuit with a battery, switch, and two bulbs in a single loop, looking clean and easy to follow.

fact.en:
What happens to the total resistance when you add more resistors in series?

It increases! Each new resistor adds its own resistance to the total, making it harder for current to flow.
fact.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa total resistance kapag nagdagdag ka ng resistors sa series?

Tumataas ito! Bawat bagong resistor ay nagdaragdag ng sarili nitong resistance sa total, kaya mas nahihirapan ang current na dumaloy.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo sa total resistance kon magdugang ka ug resistors sa series?

Motubo kini! Ang matag bag-ong resistor nagdugang sa iyang kaugalingong resistance sa total, mao nga mas maglisod ang current sa pag-agos.

title.tl: Mas Maraming Resistor, Mas Malaking Resistance
title.bis: Mas Daghang Resistor, Mas Dakong Resistance

cards.illustration: A series circuit with one resistor, then an arrow showing the same circuit with three resistors added, with the total resistance value increasing.

fact.en: A series circuit connects electrical components one after another in a single loop, so there is only one path for charges to travel.
fact.tl: Ang series circuit ay nagkakabit ng mga electrical components nang magkakasunod sa iisang loop, kaya iisa lang ang daanan ng charges.
fact.bis: Ang series circuit nagkonektar sa mga electrical components nga sunod-sunod sa usa ka loop, mao nga usa ra ka agianan ang charges.

cards.illustration: A battery connected to three bulbs in a single circular loop, with arrows showing the one path charges take around the circuit.

fact.en: For a series circuit, the total current equals the current through each part, written as IT = I1 = I2 = I3.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, ang total current ay katumbas ng current sa bawat part, isinusulat bilang IT = I1 = I2 = I3.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, ang total current katumbas sa current sa matag part, gisulat isip IT = I1 = I2 = I3.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three bulbs, each labeled I1, I2, and I3, all showing the same current value as the total current IT.

fact.en: For a series circuit, the total voltage is the sum of the individual voltages, written as VT = V1 + V2 + V3.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, ang total voltage ay ang kabuuan ng mga individual voltage, isinusulat bilang VT = V1 + V2 + V3.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, ang total voltage mao ang sum sa mga individual voltage, gisulat isip VT = V1 + V2 + V3.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three bulbs, each labeled V1, V2, and V3, with a dashed line showing their values adding up to the total voltage VT.

fact.en: For a series circuit, the total resistance is the sum of all individual resistances, written as RT = R1 + R2 + R3.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, ang total resistance ay ang kabuuan ng lahat ng individual resistance, isinusulat bilang RT = R1 + R2 + R3.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, ang total resistance mao ang sum sa tanang individual resistance, gisulat isip RT = R1 + R2 + R3.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three resistors labeled R1, R2, and R3, with a dashed line showing their values adding up to the total resistance RT.

fact.en: Safety devices like fuses and circuit breakers are connected in series with home outlets, so they can stop the current if it gets too high.
fact.tl: Ang mga safety devices tulad ng fuses at circuit breakers ay nakakabit nang series sa mga outlet sa bahay, para mapahinto nila ang current kapag masyado itong tumaas.
fact.bis: Ang mga safety devices sama sa fuses ug circuit breakers gikonektar nga series sa mga outlet sa balay, aron mapahunong nila ang current kon motaas kaayo kini.

cards.illustration: A home electrical outlet with a fuse connected in series in the wire leading to it, showing the fuse as a protective device.

fact.en:
What happens to a series circuit when one bulb burns out?

The whole circuit stops working! Because there is only one path, a break anywhere stops the current everywhere.
fact.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa series circuit kapag pumutok ang isang bulb?

Tumitigil ang buong circuit! Dahil iisa lang ang daanan, ang pagkaputol sa kahit saang bahagi ay humihinto sa current sa lahat ng bahagi.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo sa series circuit kon mapalong ang usa ka bulb?

Mihunong ang tibuok circuit! Tungod kay usa ra ang agianan, ang pagkaputol sa bisan asang parte mihunong sa current sa tanang parte.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three bulbs, one bulb darkened and broken, with the other two bulbs also dark because the current cannot flow.

fact.en: In a series circuit, the battery's voltage is divided among the components, so each component gets only a part of the total voltage.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, ang voltage ng battery ay hinahati sa mga components, kaya bawat component ay tumatanggap lamang ng bahagi ng total voltage.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, ang voltage sa battery gibahin sa mga components, mao nga ang matag component makadawat lamang ug parte sa total voltage.

cards.illustration: A battery connected to three bulbs, with the battery's voltage shown being split into three smaller voltage values, one for each bulb.

fact.en:
Why is it easier to find a problem in a series circuit?

Because all the parts are in one path, you can check them one by one until you find the broken part.
fact.tl:
Bakit mas madaling hanapin ang problema sa series circuit?

Dahil ang lahat ng parts ay nasa iisang daanan, maaari mong tingnan ang mga ito isa-isa hanggang makita mo ang sirang part.
fact.bis:
Ngano mas sayon pangitaon ang problema sa series circuit?

Tungod kay ang tanang parts naa sa usa ka agianan, mahimo nimo silang susihon usa-usa hangtod makita nimo ang guba nga part.

cards.illustration: A person's hand pointing to each bulb in a series circuit one by one, checking for the broken part along the single path.

fact.en: Using Ohm's law, if you know any two of voltage, current, and resistance, you can calculate the third one.
fact.tl: Gamit ang Ohm's law, kung alam mo ang alinman sa dalawa sa voltage, current, at resistance, makukuha mo ang pangatlo.
fact.bis: Gamit ang Ohm's law, kon nahibalo ka sa bisan asang duha sa voltage, current, ug resistance, makalkula nimo ang ikatulo.

cards.illustration: A simple equation V = IR with two values filled in and a question mark for the third, showing how to solve for the unknown.
